checks.name: RQ-017 crm_sinistre hors periode de garantie BRONZE
checks.definition:
checks for crm_sinistre:
  - failed rows:
      name: RQ-017 crm_sinistre hors periode de garantie BRONZE
      fail query: |
        SELECT s.sinistre_id FROM crm_sinistre s JOIN crm_contrat c ON c.contrat_id = s.contrat_id
        WHERE s.date_survenance < c.date_debut OR s.date_survenance > c.date_fin

  # RQ-014, volet BAN : seuils d'alerte sur le taux d'adresses non reconnues, comme le tableau de suivi de Yanis

reference.message: Samples are not sent to Soda Cloud

checks.name: RQ-014 BRONZE taux erreur BAN
checks.definition:
checks for crm_sinistre:
  - taux_erreur_adresse:
      name: RQ-014 BRONZE taux erreur BAN
      taux_erreur_adresse query: |
        SELECT 100.0 * SUM(b.id_ban IS NULL) / COUNT(*) AS taux_erreur
        FROM crm_sinistre s
        LEFT JOIN silver.ref_ban b
               ON CONCAT(b.numero, ' ', b.voie) = s.adresse_sinistre
              AND b.code_postal = s.cp_sinistre
              AND b.commune = s.ville_sinistre
      warn: when > 3
      fail: when > 10

queries.name: bronze.crm_sinistre.aggregation[0]
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN sinistre_id IS NULL THEN 1 END),
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT (cp_sinistre IS NULL) AND NOT (cp_sinistre RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}$') THEN 1 END),
  COUNT(CASE WHEN adresse_sinistre IS NULL THEN 1 END) 
FROM crm_sinistre

queries.name: bronze.crm_sinistre.sinistre_id.duplicate_count
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM crm_sinistre
    WHERE sinistre_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sinistre_id)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1

queries.name: bronze.crm_sinistre.sinistre_id.duplicate_count.failing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT sinistre_id
    FROM crm_sinistre
    WHERE sinistre_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sinistre_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM crm_sinistre main
JOIN frequencies ON main.sinistre_id = frequencies.sinistre_id

queries.name: bronze.crm_sinistre.sinistre_id.duplicate_count.passing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT sinistre_id
    FROM crm_sinistre
    WHERE sinistre_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sinistre_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM crm_sinistre main
JOIN frequencies ON main.sinistre_id = frequencies.sinistre_id

queries.name: bronze.crm_sinistre.sinistre_id.duplicate_count.failing_rows_sql_aggregated
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT sinistre_id, COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM crm_sinistre
    WHERE sinistre_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sinistre_id)
SELECT *
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 100
